LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_KoelimeBloodline.label: (Raven) Ancient Dragon Bloodline (Lesser)
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_KoelimeBloodline.descriptio: A bloodline from the ancient Draconis Koelime. Though not as overwhelming as a pureblood dragon, it still grants immunity to many lethal diseases and impressive regenerative abilities.
